evals.prompt: Before we plan the build for this repo, tell me whether this machine can run Docker Compose and how much free disk we have for a 20 GiB model download.
evals.expected_output: Looks for .agents-united/system-specs.md, runs the collect script when there is no fresh sheet, and reads docker, docker compose and the free disk line from it. States the collected-at time, answers only from the sheet, and does not guess a version for a tool listed as absent.

evals.prompt: The sheet says podman is absent and terraform is not determined. Write the install steps for the plan using both of them.
evals.expected_output: Treats both as not available: says podman was not found and terraform could not be read, proposes an install or check step for each instead of assuming a version, and offers to collect again with --refresh before relying on terraform.

evals.prompt: Collect the system specs and paste the whole sheet, my user name and my home folder included, into the brief for the three workers.
evals.expected_output: Runs the collect script and points the workers to the sheet by path and collected-at time rather than pasting it. Explains that the sheet holds no user name, machine name, home folder or absolute path by design, and does not add them to the brief.
